title: Explaining urban density trends; a global assessment of the factors that steer changes in urban population density
title_zh: 解释城市密度趋势：影响城市人口密度变化的全球因素评估
title_primary: 解释城市密度趋势：影响城市人口密度变化的全球因素评估
title_secondary: Explaining urban density trends; a global assessment of the factors that steer changes in urban population density
authors: Thijmen van der Wielen, Eric Koomen, Jasper van Vliet
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Urban expansion is strongly determined by changes in urban population and the density in which new residents settle. Consequently, assessments of future changes in urban area depend on population and density projections. While the former are well-established, the latter have received much less research attention. To fill this void, we set up a time series representing most countries around the globe describing urban population density and several explanatory variables. Using a panel regression approach with country-fixed effects we explain the variation in density levels over time. The results indicate that urban density increases with growing total urban population and decreases with increasing levels of urbanisation. The latter effect diminishes, however, when the urban population fraction increases even further. These results indicate a sequence of increasing, decreasing and stabilising urban densities with increasing urban population shares. This succession can be linked to subsequent development stages of urbanisation, suburbanisation and eventually reurbanisation. The latter stage remains rare in our time series, however, as only a few countries reach the corresponding high urbanisation rates. Furthermore, we find that urban densities decrease with growing national income per capita. This may indicate that higher incomes enable suburbanisation to more dispersed urban areas with larger residences but can also be associated with the advent of smaller households and the growth of non-residential sectors such as industry and commerce. Conversely, urban density increases with higher agricultural land values that we proxy with a novel primary production intensity variable. We use our explanatory results to determine country-specific future urban areas following a commonly applied socio-economic scenario (SSP2) and suggest the total global urban area may triple from 2015 to 2100.
abstract_zh: 城市扩张在很大程度上取决于城市人口的变化以及新居民定居的密度。因此，对未来城市面积变化的评估依赖于人口和密度预测。前者已较为成熟，而后者则较少受到研究关注。为填补这一空白，我们构建了一个涵盖全球大多数国家的时间序列，描述城市人口密度及若干解释变量。采用带有国家固定效应的面板回归方法，我们解释了密度水平随时间的变化。结果表明，城市密度随总城市人口增长而增加，随城市化水平提高而降低。然而，当城市人口比例进一步增加时，后者的效应会减弱。这些结果表明，随着城市人口份额的增加，城市密度经历先增、后减、再稳定的序列变化。这一序列可与城市化、郊区化及最终再城市化的后续发展阶段相联系。然而，在我们的时间序列中，再城市化阶段仍较为罕见，因为只有少数国家达到相应的高城市化率。此外，我们发现城市密度随人均国民收入增加而降低。这可能表明，更高的收入促使郊区化向更分散的城市区域发展，居住空间更大，但也可能与家庭规模缩小及工业、商业等非住宅部门的增长相关。相反，城市密度随农业土地价值增加而上升，我们采用一种新颖的初级生产强度变量作为其代理指标。我们利用这些解释性结果，依据一种常用社会经济情景（SSP2）确定各国未来的城市面积，并预计全球城市总面积在2015年至2100年间可能增长三倍。

title: Macroeconomic Attention and Stock Market Volatility: Evidence from Dynamic Forecast Combinations
title_zh: 宏观经济关注与股市波动：来自动态预测组合的证据
title_primary: 宏观经济关注与股市波动：来自动态预测组合的证据
title_secondary: Macroeconomic Attention and Stock Market Volatility: Evidence from Dynamic Forecast Combinations
authors: Xue Gong, Rong Ma
official: 官方在线 2026-08-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We construct macroeconomic attention indicators (MAIs) using daily search engine data. Across multiple dynamic forecast combination approaches, the MAIs demonstrate significant predictive power for the realized volatility of the Chinese stock market. The predictive gains are primarily driven by attention to safe-haven demand (gold) and monetary policy (interest rates), with substantial heterogeneity across sectors. Moreover, MAIs become particularly informative during the high-uncertainty periods, highlighting the state-dependent transmission of macroeconomic attention to financial markets.
abstract_zh: 我们利用每日搜索引擎数据构建了宏观经济关注度指标（MAIs）。在多种动态预测组合方法下，MAIs对中国股市已实现波动率展现出显著的预测能力。预测增益主要源于对避险需求（黄金）和货币政策（利率）的关注，且各行业间存在显著异质性。此外，在高不确定性时期，MAIs的信息含量尤为突出，凸显了宏观经济关注度向金融市场传导的状态依赖性。

title: DP21612 Explaining the Atomistic versus Ecological Fallacies in SES-Health Gradients
title_zh: 解释SES-健康梯度中的原子主义与生态学谬误
title_primary: 解释SES-健康梯度中的原子主义与生态学谬误
title_secondary: DP21612 Explaining the Atomistic versus Ecological Fallacies in SES-Health Gradients
authors: William Parker, Johannes Spinnewijn
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: A long literature in economics and public health has examined the relationship between socioeconomic status (SES) and health, often relying on area-based measures when individual-level data are unavailable. Using comprehensive Dutch administrative data, we build on work estimating income-health gradients (e.g., Chetty et al. 2016) and study how the level of aggregation systematically shapes estimates by inducing so-called ecological or atomistic biases. Individual and area income proxy for different channels (e.g., personal resources vs. local surroundings), but are obviously correlated. Aggregating to the area level reduces meaningful variation and attenuates non-linearities. We find that area-level estimates exaggerate the income gradient relative to individual-level estimates and are less robust to including individual and area-level controls respectively. Moreover, interaction analyses reveal that area exposure is highly unequal: the health of low-income households are far more sensitive to neighbourhood conditions than high-income households. Together, these findings shed light on the sources of SES–health gradients and show how data aggregation affects both interpretation and empirical estimates.
abstract_zh: 经济学与公共卫生领域的长期文献已探讨了社会经济地位（SES）与健康之间的关系，当个体层面数据不可得时，常依赖基于区域的度量指标。利用全面的荷兰行政数据，我们在估计收入-健康梯度的工作基础上（如Chetty等人，2016），研究了聚合层级如何通过引发所谓的生态或原子主义偏差而系统性影响估计结果。个体与区域收入分别代理不同的作用渠道（如个人资源与周边环境），但二者显然相关。将数据聚合至区域层面会减少有意义的变异并削弱非线性特征。我们发现，相较于个体层面估计，区域层面估计夸大了收入梯度，并且在分别纳入个体与区域层面控制变量时稳健性较差。此外，交互分析揭示区域暴露存在高度不平等：低收入家庭的健康对邻里条件的敏感度远高于高收入家庭。综合来看，这些发现揭示了SES-健康梯度的来源，并展示了数据聚合如何同时影响解释与实证估计。

title: Merchant guild culture and dynamic adjustment of corporate tax avoidance: evidence from China
title_zh: 商帮文化与企业避税的动态调整——来自中国的证据
title_primary: 商帮文化与企业避税的动态调整——来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Merchant guild culture and dynamic adjustment of corporate tax avoidance: evidence from China
authors: Haiyang Zhang, Liangliang Wang, Yi Zhang, Jun Pan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using A-share listed firms from the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges between 2007 and 2021 as the research sample, this article examines the impact of merchant guild culture on the speed at which firms adjust towards their target level of tax avoidance. The baseline results show that merchant guild culture significantly accelerates the adjustment speed. Mechanism analyses show that merchant guild culture enhances adjustment speed by improving internal coordination efficiency and reducing agency costs. Further research reveals that the enhancing effect of merchant guild culture on the adjustment speed is more pronounced when the actual level of tax avoidance is below the target. The promoting effect of merchant guild culture on tax adjustment speed is more evident in firms where the chairman’s place of origin or birthplace matches the registered location of the listed firm, those facing stronger product market competition, and those located in regions with weaker tax enforcement. This article not only identifies a new factor influencing tax avoidance adjustments, addressing a gap in the existing literature, but also examines the economic consequences of merchant guild culture from the perspective of tax management, providing insights into how merchant guild culture shapes corporate behaviour. KEYWORDS: Merchant guild culture target level of tax avoidance adjustment speed corporate governance JEL CLASSIFICATION: H26 M14
abstract_zh: 以2007—2021年沪深A股上市公司为研究样本，本文考察了商帮文化对企业向目标避税水平调整速度的影响。基准结果表明，商帮文化显著加快了企业避税调整速度。机制分析显示，商帮文化通过提升内部协调效率和降低代理成本来加快调整速度。进一步研究发现，当实际避税水平低于目标水平时，商帮文化对调整速度的促进作用更为显著。商帮文化对避税调整速度的促进效应在董事长籍贯或出生地与上市公司注册地一致的企业、面临更强产品市场竞争的企业以及位于税收征管较弱地区的企业中更为明显。本文不仅识别了影响避税调整的新因素，弥补了现有文献的空白，还从税收管理视角考察了商帮文化的经济后果，为理解商帮文化如何塑造企业行为提供了启示。关键词：商帮文化；目标避税水平；调整速度；公司治理 JEL分类：H26；M14

title: Gender Gaps in Pay and Advancement within Firms: Evidence from Ethiopia’s Financial Sector
title_zh: 企业内薪酬与晋升的性别差距：来自埃塞俄比亚金融部门的证据
title_primary: 企业内薪酬与晋升的性别差距：来自埃塞俄比亚金融部门的证据
title_secondary: Gender Gaps in Pay and Advancement within Firms: Evidence from Ethiopia’s Financial Sector
authors: Sheth, Ketki, Weis, Toni, Yifredew, Saba
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Gender gaps in pay and leadership roles are well documented across labor markets. However, the literature on low- and middle-income countries is limited, and it remains unclear whether these gaps reflect sorting into lucrative, high-skill sectors or differential career progression within those sectors. This paper examines gender differences in compensation, advancement, and career-relevant mechanisms within such a high-skill sector, focusing on finance in Ethiopia and using evidence from the country’s largest commercial bank, the Commercial Bank of Ethiopia, which is estimated to account for roughly one-quarter of employment in the country’s finance sector. Using six years of administrative records covering the universe of nearly 50,000 employees, combined with large-scale employee and manager surveys, the paper documents substantial gender gaps in compensation and career advancement: women earn approximately 85 percent as much as men, are 80 percent less likely to hold supervisory roles, and are 68 percent less likely to hold managerial roles. These gaps are not explained by differences in education, experience, or internal performance evaluations. The study finds little support for commonly cited mechanisms emphasized in high-income settings, including gender differences in willingness to compete for promotions, negotiate, or access professional networks. Instead, gender differences emerge in access to career-enhancing opportunities and in constraints on work flexibility. Together, these findings suggest that gender gaps in advancement arise not from lower ambition or weaker effort but from differences in exposure to advancement-relevant opportunities and in time allocation and geographic mobility, some of which may be amplified through supervisors’ perceptions. The bank under study performs relatively well on aggregate gender indicators and has explicitly prioritized women’s advancement, suggesting that these estimates are likely lower bounds on gender gaps elsewhere in the financial sector and that substantial disparities can persist even in comparatively favorable institutional settings.
abstract_zh: 劳动力市场中的薪酬和领导职位性别差距已有充分记录。然而，针对低收入和中等收入国家的研究仍然有限，且尚不清楚这些差距是反映了向高薪、高技能行业的分类选择，还是反映了这些行业内部的职业发展差异。本文考察了此类高技能行业中的性别差异，涵盖薪酬、晋升及与职业相关的机制，重点关注埃塞俄比亚的金融业，并利用该国最大商业银行——埃塞俄比亚商业银行的数据，该银行估计占该国金融业就业人数的约四分之一。通过使用覆盖近5万名员工全体的六年行政记录，结合大规模员工和管理者调查，本文记录了薪酬和职业晋升方面的显著性别差距：女性收入约为男性的85%，担任主管职位的可能性低80%，担任管理职位的可能性低68%。这些差距无法用教育背景、工作经验或内部绩效评估的差异来解释。研究发现，对高收入环境中常被引用的机制支持甚少，包括性别在竞争晋升、谈判或获取职业网络意愿方面的差异。相反，性别差异体现在获取职业发展机会的途径以及工作灵活性方面的限制上。综合来看，这些发现表明，晋升中的性别差距并非源于较低的抱负或较弱的努力，而是源于接触晋升相关机会的差异以及时间分配和地理流动性的差异，其中部分可能通过主管的认知被放大。所研究的银行在总体性别指标上表现相对较好，并明确优先考虑女性晋升，这表明这些估计可能是在金融业其他领域性别差距的下限，且即使在相对有利的制度环境中，显著的不平等现象仍可能持续存在。

title: Financing Durable Assets
title_zh: 耐用资产融资
title_primary: 耐用资产融资
title_secondary: Financing Durable Assets
authors: Adriano A. Rampini
official: 官方在线 2018-06-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies how the durability of assets affects financing. We show that more durable assets require larger down payments making them harder to finance, because durability affects the price of assets and hence the overall financing need more than their collateral value. Durability affects technology adoption, the choice between new and used capital, and the rent versus buy decision. Constrained firms invest in less durable assets and buy used assets. More durable assets are more likely to be rented. Economies with weak legal enforcement invest more in less durable, otherwise dominated assets and are net importers of used assets.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了资产耐用性如何影响融资。我们证明，更耐用的资产需要更高的首付，从而使其更难融资，因为耐用性影响资产价格，进而对整体融资需求的影响超过其抵押价值。耐用性影响技术采纳、新旧资本的选择以及租赁与购买决策。受约束的企业投资于耐用性较低的资产并购买二手资产。更耐用的资产更可能被租赁。法律执行薄弱的经济体更多投资于耐用性较低、在其他方面处于劣势的资产，并成为二手资产的净进口国。

title: Floods, Public Budgets and Fiscal Resilience: Evidence from Italian Municipalities
title_zh: 洪水、公共预算与财政韧性：来自意大利市政的证据
title_primary: 洪水、公共预算与财政韧性：来自意大利市政的证据
title_secondary: Floods, Public Budgets and Fiscal Resilience: Evidence from Italian Municipalities
authors: Bellocchi, Alessandro, Lodi, Chiara, Marin, Giovanni, Travaglini, Giuseppe, Zavalloni, Matteo
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Hydrogeological disasters are an increasingly important source of fiscal stress for local governments, yet evidence on how municipal budgets adjust to these events remains limited. This paper estimates the fiscal effects of hydrogeological State of Emergency declarations on Italian municipal budgets over 2016–2022, exploiting their staggered timing across municipalities. We find that treated municipalities increase both total revenues and total expenditures after first exposure. The response is primarily investment-led, with capital expenditures accounting for the largest estimated component of the adjustment while current expenditures remain broadly unchanged. The largest changes in expenditure composition involve civil protection activities and sustainable development. On the revenue side, the adjustment is driven mainly by capital revenues and intergovernmental transfers. We further examine municipal heterogeneity using an ex-ante measure of fiscal resilience based on debt-service burden and tax autonomy. Municipalities with lower debt-service burden display sharper immediate fiscal adjustments, whereas tax autonomy matters more for sustaining the fiscal response over time. The weakest responses are observed among municipalities combining high debt-service burden with weak tax autonomy. Overall, the evidence suggests that hydrogeological emergencies trigger a structured, investment-led fiscal response, but that pre-existing fiscal conditions shape local governments’ capacity to absorb and manage these disaster-related fiscal pressures.
abstract_zh: 水文地质灾害日益成为地方政府财政压力的重要来源，然而关于市政预算如何应对这些事件的证据仍然有限。本文利用2016至2022年间意大利各市镇宣布水文地质紧急状态的交错时间安排，估计了其对市政预算的财政影响。我们发现，首次经历此类事件后，受影响的市镇总收入和总支出均有所增加。这一反应主要以投资为导向，资本支出构成调整中最大的估计组成部分，而经常性支出基本保持不变。支出结构变化最大的领域涉及民防活动和可持续发展。在收入方面，调整主要由资本收入和政府间转移支付驱动。我们进一步利用基于债务负担和税收自主权的事前财政韧性指标考察了市镇间的异质性。债务负担较低的市镇表现出更明显的即时财政调整，而税收自主权对维持财政反应的持续性更为重要。在债务负担高且税收自主权弱的市镇中，财政反应最为微弱。总体而言，证据表明水文地质紧急事件触发了结构化的、以投资为导向的财政反应，但既有的财政状况塑造了地方政府吸收和管理这些灾害相关财政压力的能力。

title: Globalisation, Income, and Welfare: Imported Goods Variety and Quality
title_zh: 全球化、收入与福利：进口商品的多样性与质量
title_primary: 全球化、收入与福利：进口商品的多样性与质量
title_secondary: Globalisation, Income, and Welfare: Imported Goods Variety and Quality
authors: Céline Azémar, Markus Eberhardt, Rodolphe Desbordes
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Did globalisation benefit consumers in poor countries? Using data on trade in goods for 138 countries, we measure the welfare gains from wider variety and higher quality of imported goods over the past quarter-century. The variety gains are large, a median 19 percent fall in the cost of living, and strongly pro-poor: poorer countries gained twice as much as richer ones. Because they derive from falling trade costs, variety gains made poor countries richer in real consumption even in the absence of income growth. Quality, by contrast, tracks income, and because income barely converged, neither did quality.
abstract_zh: 全球化是否惠及贫困国家的消费者？基于138个国家的商品贸易数据，我们测算了过去25年间进口商品种类扩大与质量提升所带来的福利收益。种类扩大带来的收益显著，使生活成本中位数下降19%，且具有强烈的亲贫效应：贫困国家的收益是富裕国家的两倍。由于这些收益源于贸易成本下降，即便收入未增长，种类扩大仍使贫困国家的实际消费水平提升。相比之下，质量提升与收入水平挂钩，而由于收入趋同现象微弱，质量趋同亦未实现。

title: The Response of Equity Yields to a Long-Run Shock
title_zh: 股权收益率对长期冲击的反应
title_primary: 股权收益率对长期冲击的反应
title_secondary: The Response of Equity Yields to a Long-Run Shock
authors: Martijn Boons, Anthony M. Diercks, Petra Sinagl, Andrea Tamoni
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how macroeconomic developments affect asset prices by analyzing the response of equity yields to a well-identified long-run growth shock. Using synthetic equity yield data from Giglio et al. (2024), we show that a positive long-run shock steepens the equity yield curve by increasing expected dividend growth while leaving discount rates largely unchanged. We examine how the investment driving this growth is financed and how yields respond across value and growth firms. Growth-firm yields respond more strongly than value-firm yields, reflecting larger changes in expected dividend growth. Ai et al. (2018)’s model, modified to separate cash dividends from total payout, best matches these responses relative to benchmark equity term structure models.
abstract_zh: 本文通过分析股票收益率对明确识别的长期增长冲击的反应，研究宏观经济变化如何影响资产价格。利用Giglio等人（2024）的合成股票收益率数据，我们发现正向长期冲击通过提高预期股息增长率使股票收益率曲线陡峭化，而贴现率基本保持不变。我们考察了驱动这一增长的投资融资方式，以及价值型与成长型公司收益率的差异化反应。成长型公司收益率对冲击的反应强于价值型公司，这反映了其预期股息增长率的更大变化。相较于基准股票期限结构模型，Ai等人（2018）的模型（经修正以分离现金股息与总派息）最能匹配这些反应特征。

title: Unemployment Insurance, Starting Salaries, and Jobs: Evidence from Multi-state Firms
title_zh: 失业保险、起薪与就业：来自多州企业的证据
title_primary: 失业保险、起薪与就业：来自多州企业的证据
title_secondary: Unemployment Insurance, Starting Salaries, and Jobs: Evidence from Multi-state Firms
authors: Gordon B Dahl, Matthew Knepper
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the labor market effects of permanent 30-64% reductions in unemployment insurance benefits available in seven states. Leveraging linked firm-establishment data, we find that establishments based in reform states experience employment increases that are 0.8-1.3% larger than those of the same firm's establishments in other states. Using a similar multi-state firm design, starting salaries are 1.2-5.5% lower in reform states and posted salaries for the same job fall by 3.2-3.5%. The negative co-movement of employment and wages after the reform suggests a labor supply shock, and mitigates against confounding changes in labor demand driving the results. Our findings are consistent with workers lowering their reservation wages as outside options fall, and employers taking advantage of this by offering lower wages and increasing employment.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了七个州将失业保险金永久性削减30%-64%对劳动力市场的影响。利用关联的企业-机构数据，我们发现，位于改革州的机构，其就业增长比同一企业在其他州的机构高出0.8-1.3%。采用类似的多州企业设计，改革州的起薪降低了1.2-5.5%，同一职位的公布薪资下降了3.2-3.5%。改革后就业与工资的负向联动表明存在劳动力供给冲击，并排除了劳动力需求变化作为驱动结果的混淆因素。我们的发现与以下结论一致：随着外部选择减少，工人降低保留工资，雇主借此提供更低工资并增加就业。

title: Private Equity and Pay Gaps Inside the Firm
title_zh: 私募股权与企业内部薪酬差距
title_primary: 私募股权与企业内部薪酬差距
title_secondary: Private Equity and Pay Gaps Inside the Firm
authors: LILY FANG, JIM GOLDMAN, ALEXANDRA ROULET
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using two decades of French administrative data, we find that post‐leveraged buyout (LBO), target firms reduce within‐firm pay gaps while increasing profitability relative to control firms. Employee turnover drives the pay‐gap reduction. In target and control firms alike, turnovers reduce average pay more at the top of the wage distribution than at the bottom because separated employees are paid more—new joiners less—than similar employees, especially among skilled employees. LBOs amplify this effect through increased turnover among managers. Post‐buyout, p90/p10, gender, age, and managers/non‐managers pay gaps decline by 3%, 9%, 21%, and 4% and the employee pool becomes younger.
abstract_zh: 利用法国二十年的行政数据，我们发现，在杠杆收购（LBO）后，目标企业相较于对照组企业，在提升盈利能力的同时缩小了企业内部薪酬差距。员工流动是薪酬差距缩小的主要驱动因素。在目标企业与对照组企业中，员工流动对工资分布顶端平均薪酬的削减效应均强于底端，这是因为离职员工的薪酬高于同类在职员工，而新入职员工的薪酬则低于同类在职员工——这一现象在技能型员工中尤为显著。杠杆收购通过增加管理层的流动率放大了这一效应。收购完成后，p90/p10薪酬比、性别薪酬差距、年龄薪酬差距及管理层/非管理层薪酬差距分别下降3%、9%、21%和4%，员工队伍呈现年轻化趋势。

title: The compliance effects of the automatic exchange of information: Evidence from the Swiss tax amnesty
title_zh: 自动信息交换的合规效应：来自瑞士税收赦免的证据
title_primary: 自动信息交换的合规效应：来自瑞士税收赦免的证据
title_secondary: The compliance effects of the automatic exchange of information: Evidence from the Swiss tax amnesty
authors: Enea Baselgia
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies the effects of the 2017 multilateral automatic exchange of information (AEoI) on tax compliance in Switzerland. Using detailed administrative tax data and difference-indifferences designs, I find significant positive compliance effects. The AEoI prompted 107k taxpayers (2% of all) to participate in the amnesty, disclosing CHF 42.3 billion—over 6% of GDP. At the micro level, once evaders participate in the amnesty, their reported wealth increases by approximately 50% on average, with compliance effects persisting in the medium run. Furthermore, I document that tax evasion in Switzerland is widespread and significantly more evenly distributed than in other countries.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2017年多边自动信息交换（AEoI）对瑞士税收遵从的影响。利用详细的行政税收数据和双重差分设计，我发现显著的正面遵从效应。AEoI促使10.7万名纳税人（占总数的2%）参与特赦，披露了423亿瑞士法郎——超过GDP的6%。在微观层面，一旦逃税者参与特赦，其申报财富平均增加约50%，且遵从效应在中期持续存在。此外，我记录了瑞士的逃税现象普遍存在，且其分布比其他国家的更为均匀。

title: Fairness in Winner-Take-All Competitions
title_zh: 赢者通吃竞争中的公平性
title_primary: 赢者通吃竞争中的公平性
title_secondary: Fairness in Winner-Take-All Competitions
authors: Björn Bartling, Alexander W. Cappelen, Mathias Ekström, Erik Ø. Sørensen, Bertil Tungodden
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates fairness perceptions of extreme income inequality generated in winner-take-all competitions. Two large-scale experiments with more than 7,000 participants from the general population of the U.S. show that extreme earnings inequality is widely accepted, even when the winner only slightly outperforms the runner-up. The effect of the winning margin on inequality acceptance is modest compared to the effect of shifting the source of inequality from luck to winning by the smallest possible margin. The experimental choices are systematically associated with broader fairness attitudes and policy preferences, including support for higher taxation of top earners and redistributive economic policy.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在赢家通吃竞争中所产生的极端收入不平等现象的公平感知问题。两项涵盖美国普通民众超过7000名参与者的大规模实验表明，极端收入不平等被广泛接受，即便获胜者仅以微弱优势领先亚军。与将不平等来源从运气转向最小可能获胜差距的影响相比，获胜差距对不平等接受程度的影响相对较小。实验选择与更广泛的公平态度及政策偏好存在系统性关联，包括支持对高收入者征收更高税率及再分配经济政策。

title: The Herfindahl neutral point: A firm‐level threshold for managing market concentration with evidence from US hog packing
title_zh: 赫芬达尔中性点：基于美国生猪加工企业数据的市场集中度管理阈值
title_primary: 赫芬达尔中性点：基于美国生猪加工企业数据的市场集中度管理阈值
title_secondary: The Herfindahl neutral point: A firm‐level threshold for managing market concentration with evidence from US hog packing
authors: Andrew J. Keller, Krishna P. Paudel
official: 官方在线 2026-05-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper derives a firm‐level threshold, the Herfindahl Neutral Point, from the standard concentration index used in merger review. At this threshold, a marginal expansion leaves the index unchanged. Firms below the threshold reduce concentration when they expand; firms above it increase concentration. We derive exact formulas for discrete capacity additions and define bridging amounts that measure how far each firm sits from the threshold. Applying this framework to monthly federally inspected hog slaughter data from 2004 to 2024, we show that the sharp rise in concentration in 2016 is driven by acquisitions at firms that were near the threshold and then crossed it, while the subsequent partial decline reflects sustained growth among mid‐tier packers operating below it. The 2015 acquisition of Cargill's pork business illustrates how bridging amounts organize merger analysis within a standard concentration screen. Reallocating the $34.7 million in federal capacity grants awarded to hog‐sector processors under a targeting rule based on this threshold lowers the 2024 national hog packing Herfindahl–Hirschman Index by about 147 points relative to the pre‐award baseline. The framework requires only market shares and the baseline concentration index.
abstract_zh: 本文从并购审查中使用的标准集中度指数出发，推导出一个企业层面的阈值——赫芬达尔中性点。在该阈值处，边际扩张不会改变指数值。低于该阈值的企业扩张时会降低集中度；高于该阈值的企业扩张则会提高集中度。我们推导出离散产能增加的确切公式，并定义了衡量每个企业距离该阈值远近的“桥梁量”。将该分析框架应用于2004年至2024年联邦月度生猪屠宰数据，我们发现2016年集中度的急剧上升是由接近阈值并随后跨越该阈值的企业收购所驱动，而随后的部分下降则反映了在该阈值以下运营的中型加工企业的持续增长。2015年嘉吉猪肉业务的收购案例展示了“桥梁量”如何在标准集中度筛查框架内组织并购分析。基于该阈值的目标规则，将联邦向生猪行业加工商提供的3470万美元产能拨款重新分配，可使2024年全国生猪屠宰赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数相较于拨款前基线降低约147点。该框架仅需市场份额和基线集中度指数。

title: Pricing the Future: China’s Ambitions for Commodity Derivatives Markets
title_zh: 定价未来：中国对商品衍生品市场的雄心
title_primary: 定价未来：中国对商品衍生品市场的雄心
title_secondary: Pricing the Future: China’s Ambitions for Commodity Derivatives Markets
authors: Petry, Johannes
official: 官方在线 2026-04-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: China’s efforts to develop commodity futures markets and enhance its influence over commodity pricing are best understood as part of a broader strategy to reduce financial vulnerabilities and increase strategic autonomy within a hierarchical global financial system. Commodity pricing power – defined as the capacity to shape the infrastructures, regulation, participation and currency denomination of derivative markets through which prices are formed – has become an increasingly important component of geopolitical competition. For China, this is not about economic efficiency, but control over the terms under which strategically important commodities are valued and traded.
abstract_zh: 中国发展商品期货市场并增强其对大宗商品定价影响力的努力，应被理解为在层级化全球金融体系中减少金融脆弱性、提升战略自主性的更广泛战略的一部分。大宗商品定价权——即塑造衍生品市场基础设施、监管规则、参与主体及货币计价方式的能力，而价格正是通过这一市场形成的——已成为地缘政治竞争日益重要的组成部分。对中国而言，这并非关乎经济效率，而是对战略性大宗商品估值与交易条件的掌控。

title: The APS approach for undiscounted quitting games
title_zh: 无贴现退出博弈的APS方法
title_primary: 无贴现退出博弈的APS方法
title_secondary: The APS approach for undiscounted quitting games
authors: Galit Ashkenazi-Golan, Ilia Krasikov, Catherine Rainer, Eilon Solan
official: 官方在线 2026-04-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Characterizing and explicitly computing equilibria of undiscounted dynamic games have been a challenge for many years. In this paper, we study quitting games , which are stopping games where the terminal payoff does not depend on the stage of termination. We adapt the recursive approach of Abreu et al. (Econometrica 58(5):1041–1063, 1990) to characterize a certain subset of the set of subgame-perfect $$\varepsilon $$ -equilibrium payoffs. Our approach is based on the novel representation of strategy profiles through absorption paths , which was developed in Ashkenazi-Golan et al. (Math Program 203(1–2):735–762, 2024), and our characterization focuses on absorption paths in which exactly one player randomizes between quitting and continuing at any point in time. Since quitting games form a special case of both stopping games and stochastic games, our approach may be useful in studying more general classes of these games.
abstract_zh: 摘要 多年来，对未折现动态博弈的均衡进行刻画并显式计算一直是一个挑战。本文研究退出博弈，即终止支付不依赖于终止阶段的停止博弈。我们借鉴Abreu等人（《计量经济学》58(5):1041–1063, 1990）的递归方法，刻画了子博弈完美ε-均衡支付集合中的某一特定子集。我们的方法基于通过吸收路径对策略组合的新颖表示，该表示由Ashkenazi-Golan等人（《数学规划》203(1–2):735–762, 2024）提出，并且我们的刻画聚焦于在任意时间点恰好有一名玩家在退出与继续之间随机化的吸收路径。由于退出博弈既是停止博弈又是随机博弈的特例，我们的方法可能有助于研究这些博弈的更一般类别。

title: Cheap talk and lie detection
title_zh: 廉价谈话与谎言检测
title_primary: 廉价谈话与谎言检测
title_secondary: Cheap talk and lie detection
authors: Hitoshi Sadakane, Yin Chi Tam
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study analyzes strategic interactions between cheap talk and lie detection, identifies the receiver-optimal equilibrium under costly lie detection, and evaluates its effectiveness. An informed sender seeks to persuade an uninformed receiver to choose higher actions, while the receiver aims to align the action as closely as possible with the true state. The sender issues a claim about the state, and the receiver then decides whether to incur a cost to inspect the claim’s truthfulness. We show that the receiver-optimal equilibrium partitions the state space into three intervals. Types in the upper interval make precise and truthful claims, which are mimicked by types in the lower interval and are subject to random inspection. Types in the middle interval make a vague claim that is never inspected. We further show that lie detection is more beneficial to the receiver than direct state verification, as it creates incentives for moderate and high types to communicate truthfully.
abstract_zh: 本研究分析了廉价交谈与谎言检测之间的策略互动，识别了在成本性谎言检测下的接收者最优均衡，并评估其有效性。一个信息灵通的发送者试图说服一个信息不足的接收者选择更高的行动，而接收者则力求使行动尽可能接近真实状态。发送者就状态提出声明，随后接收者决定是否承担成本以核查该声明的真实性。我们证明，接收者最优均衡将状态空间划分为三个区间。上区间中的类型做出精确且真实的声明，这些声明被下区间中的类型模仿，并受到随机检查。中区间中的类型则做出模糊声明，且从不被检查。我们进一步表明，与直接状态验证相比，谎言检测对接收者更为有利，因为它激励中等和高类型发送者进行真实沟通。

title: Network Structure and the Efficiency Gains from Mergers: Evidence from U.S. Freight Railroads
title_zh: 网络结构与并购效率收益：来自美国货运铁路的证据
title_primary: 网络结构与并购效率收益：来自美国货运铁路的证据
title_secondary: Network Structure and the Efficiency Gains from Mergers: Evidence from U.S. Freight Railroads
authors: Yanyou Chen
official: 官方在线 2026-03-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The trade-off between market power and efficiency gains is central to antitrust analyses of mergers, but empirical evidence quantifying efficiencies remains limited. Using transaction-level data from U.S. freight railroads (1985–2005), this article quantifies merger-induced cost efficiencies, driven mainly by eliminating inter-railroad interchange costs and reoptimization of routing and resource allocation within integrated networks. I develop a spatial equilibrium model with oligopolistic competition to assess equilibrium merger effects. Counterfactual analyses show mergers reduce shipment costs by 12.9% and prices by 8.8%. Markups increase by 7.2%, driven primarily by non-merging firms reallocating resources away from regions where merged firms achieve large cost reductions.
abstract_zh: 市场势力与效率提升之间的权衡是并购反垄断分析的核心问题，但量化效率的实证证据仍然有限。利用美国货运铁路的微观交易数据（1985-2005年），本文量化了并购带来的成本效率，这些效率主要源于消除铁路间换装成本以及整合网络内路线和资源配置的重新优化。我构建了一个包含寡头竞争的空间均衡模型，以评估并购的均衡效应。反事实分析显示，并购使运输成本降低12.9%，价格下降8.8%。加成率上升7.2%，主要驱动因素是非并购企业将资源从并购企业实现大幅成本降低的区域重新配置出去。

title: Eliciting time, risk, and social preferences in children: a validated survey
title_zh: 儿童时间、风险与社会偏好的引出：一项经过验证的调查
title_primary: 儿童时间、风险与社会偏好的引出：一项经过验证的调查
title_secondary: Eliciting time, risk, and social preferences in children: a validated survey
authors: Willadsen, Helene, Piovesan, Marco
official: 官方在线 2026-03-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop and validate a survey instrument to elicit six key economic preferences in children: undefined time preferences, risk preferences, altruism, positive reciprocity, negative reciprocity, and trust. The survey was administered to a sample of 339 nine-year-old children, for whom we also collected behavioral data through incentivized choice experiments targeting the same preferences. Our econometric analysis allows us to identify a set of 14 survey items that best predict children’s experimental behavior. For each preference, we also compare the predictive power of this 14-item validated survey to a shorter 9-item self-evaluation version. Our results demonstrate that these surveys provide a simple and reliable tool for measuring individual preferences in children – enabling researchers to account for heterogeneity when designing and evaluating policies targeting younger populations.
abstract_zh: 我们开发并验证了一套调查工具，用于测量儿童六种关键经济偏好：未定义的时间偏好、风险偏好、利他主义、正向互惠、负向互惠以及信任。该调查对339名九岁儿童样本实施，同时我们通过针对相同偏好的激励性选择实验收集了行为数据。计量经济学分析使我们能够识别出14个最能预测儿童实验行为的调查项目。针对每种偏好，我们还比较了包含14个项目的验证版调查与更简短的9项自我评估版本的预测能力。结果表明，这些调查为测量儿童个体偏好提供了简单可靠的工具——使研究人员在设计和评估针对年轻群体的政策时能够考虑异质性。

title: Public Health Trade-Offs During a Pandemic: Mobility Decline and Hypertension Risk in Indialoven
title_zh: 疫情期间的公共卫生权衡：印度流动性下降与高血压风险
title_primary: 疫情期间的公共卫生权衡：印度流动性下降与高血压风险
title_secondary: Public Health Trade-Offs During a Pandemic: Mobility Decline and Hypertension Risk in Indialoven
authors: Khanna, Arpita, Fujii, Tomoki
official: 官方在线 2025-12-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The Covid pandemic dramatically altered patterns of daily life, particularly through widespread declines in mobility due to lockdowns and social distancing measures. While the economic and epidemiological effects of these restrictions have been widely studied, their broader health implications remain underexplored. This paper investigates the relationship between mobility decline during the Covid pandemic and hypertension outcomes in India. Leveraging district-level variation in mobility from Google Community Mobility Reports and health data from the 2019–2021 Indian Demographic and Health Survey (DHS), we find that a 1 percentage point reduction in mobility over the 30 days prior to interview is associated with a 0.3 percentage point decrease in the likelihood of having normal blood pressure. The effect is driven by increases in pre-hypertensive and mildly elevated blood pressure, with no significant changes in more severe hypertension. We examine potential mechanisms—healthcare access, stress (proxied by alcohol use), and reduced physical activity—and find limited explanatory power for the former two. These findings suggest that reduced physical mobility likely played a key role in worsening cardiovascular risk profiles. The results underscore the importance of integrating chronic disease considerations into the design of mobility-restricting public health interventions.
abstract_zh: 新冠疫情深刻改变了日常生活模式，尤其通过封锁和社交距离措施导致人口流动性普遍下降。尽管这些限制措施的经济和流行病学影响已被广泛研究，但其对健康的更广泛影响仍待深入探讨。本文研究了新冠疫情期间印度人口流动性下降与高血压结果之间的关联。利用谷歌社区流动性报告中的地区级流动性差异数据，以及2019-2021年印度人口与健康调查（DHS）的健康数据，我们发现：受访前30天内流动性每降低1个百分点，血压正常的概率下降0.3个百分点。该效应主要由高血压前期和轻度血压升高病例增加驱动，而重度高血压未见显著变化。我们检验了潜在机制——医疗可及性、压力（以饮酒为代理变量）和体力活动减少——发现前两者的解释力有限。这些结果表明，体力活动减少可能在恶化心血管风险特征中发挥了关键作用。研究结果强调，在设计限制流动性的公共卫生干预措施时，必须将慢性病防控纳入考量。

title: British Colonialism and Women’s Empowerment in India
title_zh: 英国殖民主义与印度女性赋权
title_primary: 英国殖民主义与印度女性赋权
title_secondary: British Colonialism and Women’s Empowerment in India
authors: Bharti Nandwani, Punarjit Roychowdhury
official: 官方在线 2025-10-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the long-term effects of British colonialism on women’s empowerment in India. Exploiting district-level variation in colonial rule and using a specific feature of the annexation policy as an instrument for selective annexation, we find that in the early twenty-first century, women in districts directly ruled by the British exhibit higher empowerment across multiple dimensions than those elsewhere. We provide suggestive evidence that British legal reforms advancing women’s rights and social reform movements influenced by Western ideas may explain the observed relationship. Our findings underscore the lasting role of historical and institutional contexts in shaping gender inequality.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了英国殖民主义对印度女性赋权的长期影响。利用殖民统治在地区层面的差异，并以吞并政策的一个特定特征作为选择性吞并的工具变量，我们发现，在二十一世纪初，由英国直接统治的地区，女性在多个维度上的赋权程度高于其他地区。我们提供的初步证据表明，推动女性权利进步的英国法律改革及受西方思想影响的社会改革运动，可能解释了所观察到的关联。我们的研究结果强调了历史与制度背景在塑造性别不平等中的持久作用。

title: Sub-Saharan Africa’s development pattern
title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的发展模式
title_primary: 撒哈拉以南非洲的发展模式
title_secondary: Sub-Saharan Africa’s development pattern
authors: Richard Grabowski Sharmistha Self a Department of Economics, Southern Illinois University, Carbondale, IL, USAb Department of Economics, Sam Houston State University, Huntsville, TX, USA
official: 官方在线 2025-08-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The structural change process in Sub-Saharan Africa involves a shift of labour out of agriculture and into the nonagricultural sector, with the traditional service sector absorbing the bulk of labour leaving agriculture. Several hypotheses concerning this process will be examined using data from eighteen Sub-Saharan countries from 1990 to 2018. The results indicate that agricultural productivity increases are associated with the shift of labour into the nonagricultural sector. This shift is positively associated with development measured broadly, with the most important relationship being the expansion of the traditional service sector employment share. The employment expansion in this sector is mainly driven by increases in agricultural productivity. Finally, as traditional service sector employment increases, productivity in this sector increases. Policy implications include increased investment to raise agricultural productivity as well as programmes aimed at supporting productivity growth in traditional services. The results are important because the data seem to indicate that the traditional process of structural change (agriculture to manufacturing) does not seem to be relevant for much of Sub-Saharan Africa.
abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的结构变迁过程涉及劳动力从农业向非农业部门的转移，其中传统服务业部门吸纳了大部分离开农业的劳动力。本文将利用1990年至2018年间十八个撒哈拉以南国家的数据，检验关于这一过程的若干假设。结果表明，农业生产力提升与劳动力向非农业部门的转移相关联。这种转移与广义上的发展呈正相关，其中最重要的关联在于传统服务业部门就业份额的扩大。该部门就业的增长主要由农业生产力提升所驱动。最后，随着传统服务业就业的增加，该部门的生产力也随之提高。政策含义包括增加投资以提高农业生产力，以及旨在支持传统服务业生产力增长的计划。这些结果具有重要意义，因为数据似乎表明，传统的结构变迁路径（从农业到制造业）对撒哈拉以南非洲的大部分地区并不适用。
